elements.name: Early morning open bus station yard
Soft gold light and long shadows
Single-file queue of men and women seen from behind
Queue running in a long curve across the yard
Small ticket window in a low building at the head of the queue
Young man with backpack as last in queue, nearest, seen from behind
Long-distance buses parked along one side

notes: Rebuild the queue as a true single file curving across the yard to a clearly visible ticket window in the low building (people are bunched side by side heading toward the buses), centre the young man, give him closed-toe buckle sandals, and remove the unrequested cup from his hand.
